author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices big leaps, verse and chorus, counting in threes and two-hand teamwork, with an old song about a friend across the sea.

classes.title: Ride the big wave
classes.goal: Find the hand's place from low G to E and feel the song's big jump up.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes are next door; this one jumps far

classes.parentPrompt: Help the thumb find low G, then show your child how far E is: a big wave.
classes.childAction: Thumb on low G, then jump up to E like a wave.
classes.bridge: Low G is the boat; E is the top of a big wave, far right.

intro.caption: Low G is the boat
intro.parentCue: help the thumb find low G, left of middle C

games.caption: Boat to wave: G up to E
games.parentCue: Point low on G, then lift your arm on E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place and one big leap.

classes.title: Up the wave, down to shore
classes.goal: Play the first line: one big leap up, then little steps all the way down.

mathTarget.parentLine: One big jump up, then many small steps down

classes.parentPrompt: Lift your hand high on the leap, then let it float down in little waves.
classes.childAction: Leap up to E, then step down, key by key, to low G.
classes.bridge: The boat climbs one big wave on the right, then rolls down to the left.

intro.caption: One big leap, many small steps
intro.parentCue: lift your hand high, then float down

games.caption: My Bonnie lies over the ocean
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers out loud, slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a big leap and steps down.

classes.title: Story part, calling part
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the verse and the 'bring back' chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song can have a story part and a calling part

classes.parentPrompt: Sway on the verse; cup your hands round your mouth for 'bring back'. Sing stuck words.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot when the 'bring back' part starts.
classes.bridge: The verse tells the story; the chorus calls across the sea: bring back!

intro.caption: Story part, calling part
intro.parentCue: cup your hands and call on 'bring back'

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the verse and chorus of a song.

classes.title: Long calls, count to three
classes.goal: Hold each long 'bring back' note for three full beats.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each long note lasts exactly three counts

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' slowly on each long note while your child holds the key.
classes.childAction: Hold each long note while counting one, two, three.
classes.bridge: Each long note is a call across the water: hold it until it reaches.

intro.caption: Hold it for three
intro.parentCue: count 'one, two, three' on every long note

games.caption: Bring back, bring back
games.parentCue: Count to three on each note together

games.caption: Hold it: C, then D
games.parentCue: Count three on each long note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: holding long notes for three counts.

classes.title: Rock the boat in three
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar: One-two-three.

mathTarget.parentLine: This song rocks in threes: One, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays the low notes. Count one-two-three, loud on one.
classes.childAction: Play one low note on each big one, then rock for two, three.
classes.bridge: The low note is the boat dipping down; two, three is the boat rocking back.

intro.caption: Low note on one
intro.parentCue: count to three, loud on one

games.caption: Find the low notes
games.parentCue: Point to each low key first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: landing on the first beat of each bar.

classes.title: Two hands, one boat
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note at the start of each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note for every three beats of tune

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'low' on each bar. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Right hand plays the tune; left hand plays one low note each bar.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the deep sea, slow and low; the right hand is the boat.

intro.caption: Two hands, one boat
intro.parentCue: say 'low' on each bar, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing two hands with two different jobs.

classes.title: Sail with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is the wind in the sails; keep sailing past every bump.

intro.caption: Sail along and keep going
intro.parentCue: nod on every one and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Ocean concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a gentle, rocking sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes in a soft, swaying way

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; sway gently while your child plays, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play gently, like waves rocking a boat, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Play soft and rocking, like calm waves carrying a message far away.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song gently, start to end.
